verdict.rationale: GoDaddy documents its own Auctions API for acquiring expiring domains, either by open bidding or by fixed-price Buy Now closeouts. That is a genuine first-party aftermarket path, but it only covers expiring names. The search and quote docs never mention premium-tier pricing being shown in search results. There is also no evidence of a marketplace or broker service for currently registered names. Missing for 10: premium pricing surfaced in search/availability results, a marketplace or broker path for taken (non-expiring) names, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, premium and aftermarket domains are first-class — premium pricing shown in search, and a marketplace or broker path for taken names

citations.quote: The Auctions API covers two ways to acquire expiring domains on the GoDaddy platform: bidding on expiring auctions and instant purchase of closeouts (Buy Now) auctions at a fixed price.
Buy expired or expiring domains at a fixed price or through open bidding.
